```yaml
name: Build Godot Addon

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build-linux:
    name: Build on Linux
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install build tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential

      - name: Remove amy_midi.c
        run: |
          find . -type f -name 'amy_midi.c' -delete

      - name: Compile addon
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          gcc -shared -fPIC -o build/libamy.so $(find . -name '*.c' ! -name 'amy_midi.c')
          # Create a minimal gdextension file
          echo "name=amy" > build/amy.gdextension
          echo "class_name=Amy" >> build/amy.gdextension
          echo "script=amy.gd" >> build/amy.gdextension

      - name: Package binary
        run: |
          cd build
          zip -r ../amy-linux.zip libamy.so amy.gdextension

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-linux
          path: amy-linux.zip

  build-macos:
    name: Build on macOS
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Remove amy_midi.c
        run: |
          find . -type f -name 'amy_midi.c' -delete

      - name: Compile addon
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          gcc -shared -fPIC -o build/libamy.dylib $(find . -name '*.c' ! -name 'amy_midi.c')
          echo "name=amy" > build/amy.gdextension
          echo "class_name=Amy" >> build/amy.gdextension
          echo "script=amy.gd" >> build/amy.gdextension

      - name: Package binary
        run: |
          cd build
          zip -r ../amy-macos.zip libamy.dylib amy.gdextension

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-macos
          path: amy-macos.zip

  build-windows:
    name: Build on Windows
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Remove amy_midi.c
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          for /R %%i in (amy_midi.c) do del "%%i"

      - name: Compile addon
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          mkdir build
          cl /LD /Fe:build\amy.dll $(for /R %i in (*.c) do @if /I not "%~nxi"=="amy_midi.c" echo %i) /I .
          echo name=amy > build\amy.gdextension
          echo class_name=Amy >> build\amy.gdextension
          echo script=amy.gd >> build\amy.gdextension

      - name: Package binary
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          cd build
          powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path amy.dll, amy.gdextension -DestinationPath ..\amy-windows.zip"

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-windows
          path: amy-windows.zip

  package:
    name: Package All Binaries
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build-linux, build-macos, build-windows]
    steps:
      - name: Download Linux artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-linux
          path: artifacts/linux

      - name: Download macOS artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-macos
          path: artifacts/macos

      - name: Download Windows artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-windows
          path: artifacts/windows

      - name: Combine binaries into final zip
        run: |
          mkdir -p final
          cp artifacts/linux/amy-linux.zip final/
          cp artifacts/macos/amy-macos.zip final/
          cp artifacts/windows/amy-windows.zip final/
          cd final
          zip -r ../amy-addon.zip *

      - name: Upload final addon
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: amy-addon
          path: amy-addon.zip
```
